# GlassesLayout:clearAndDisplay

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Clear layout and display text.

```lua
layout:clearAndDisplay(text)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function wakeup(context)
  context.layout:clearAndDisplay("ARMED!")
end
```
